- `recommended_version`: 1.22.3

def compute_sec_ver(remediations: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], packages: Dict
    [str, Package], secure_vulns_by_user: set, db_full: Dict[str, Any]) ->None:
    for pkg_name, specs in remediations.items():
        package = packages.get(pkg_name, None)
        if not package:
            continue

        sec_ver_for_user = compute_sec_ver_for_user(package, secure_vulns_by_user, db_full)

        for spec, remediation in specs.items():
            version = remediation.get('version', None)
            
            # Get closest secure version from all secure versions (package.secure_versions)
            all_secure = package.secure_versions if package.secure_versions else []
            closest = get_closest_ver(all_secure, version, SpecifierSet(''))
            
            # Get closest secure version for user (considering ignored vulns)
            closest_for_user = get_closest_ver(sec_ver_for_user, version, SpecifierSet(''))
            
            recommended_version = closest['upper'] if closest['upper'] else closest['lower']
            
            # Other recommended versions: secure versions for user excluding the recommended
            other_recommended = []
            if sec_ver_for_user:
                for v in sec_ver_for_user:
                    parsed_v = parse_version(v)
                    if recommended_version and parsed_v != recommended_version:
                        # Only include versions that are closest lower for user
                        if closest_for_user.get('lower') and parsed_v == closest_for_user['lower']:
                            other_recommended.append(v)
                        elif not closest_for_user.get('lower') and closest['lower'] and parsed_v == closest['lower']:
                            other_recommended.append(v)
            
            remediation['closest_secure_version'] = closest
            remediation['recommended_version'] = recommended_version
            remediation['other_recommended_versions'] = other_recommended
            
            # Update more_info_url
            more_info_url = remediation.get('more_info_url', '')
            if recommended_version and version:
                remediation['more_info_url'] = build_remediation_info_url(more_info_url, version, str(recommended_version))
```
